2026 Mediterranean Games.fact: The 2026 Mediterranean Games (Italian: Giochi del Mediterraneo 2026), officially called the XX Mediterranean Games (Italian: XX Giochi del Mediterraneo) and commonly called Taranto 2026, is an upcoming international multi-sport event in the Mediterranean Games series that is scheduled to be held from 21 August to 3 September 2026 in Taranto, Italy.
